2580.a: Marymoor Park, 6046 West Lake Sammamish Pkwy NE, Redmond, WA 98052
2580.aj: Marymoor Park, 6046 West Lake Sammamish Pkwy NE, Redmond, WA 98052 アメリカ合衆国
2580.ed: 684-acre park featuring a spacious off-leash dog area, climbing wall, soccer fields & concerts.

rv.t: One of my favorite places to go not only with my dog but just to walk around. Absolutely stunning park and nothing like it around. Many different areas for the pups to explore including the slough when it gets warmer to swim in. Have been bringing my dog here since he was 3 months old, helped him get socialized to other dogs. Never had any altercations from owners or pets. 10/10 would highly recommend.

- dog paradise!!! - It's insane how long I've live here without ever really visited this park other than the two times that I was here for cirque du soleil lol. First of all, this park is HUGE! We walked around the center or the park and we passed by 3 playgrounds, one huge dog park and a garden. There was also a climbing area and they have ropes there for that too. It doesn't look too fun since it was burning hot…

Great family night experience! We have never seen a drone show before so it was new, and so we can't compare it to anything. The only down side is that the chairs were not facing the show so we had to cock our heads the whole time to watch it. The people on the blankets probably didn't have to deal with that.

2581.a: Trader Joe's, 15932 Redmond Wy, Redmond, WA 98052
2581.aj: トレーダージョーズ 15932 Redmond Wy, Redmond, WA 98052 アメリカ合衆国
2581.ed: Grocery chain with a variety of signature items, plus produce, dairy & more (most sell wine & beer).
2581.edj: 食料品スーパーマーケット チェーン。さまざまな自社ブランド商品のほか、農産物、日用品などを販売（ほとんどがワインとビール扱う）。

rv.t: Just learned about Trader Joes and I must say: life altering experience 😻. Denise was such a helpful soul and just a sweetheart all around. She made the new and slightly overwhelming experience I was having very comfortable and rewarding. Trader Joes is now my second home. She deserves a promotion to manager. Honestly seeing a worker like her makes me question democratic capitalism.

I absolutely loved this supermarket 😍. Most of the products are their own brand, with beautiful packaging, great quality, and very good prices. Everything is so creative it feels like the Disneyland of supermarkets 🎢🛒. The hand-painted signs and the music outside give it a unique vibe, almost like being in Italy 🇮🇹. Can’t wait to come back!

Absolutely love this store! The selection is always unique and fresh, plus the staff is super friendly and helpful. I can’t get enough of their snacks and ready-to-eat meals—definitely my go-to grocery spot!

2582.aj: アメリカ合衆国 ワシントン州 レドモンド

2583.aj: 〒238-0019 神奈川県横須賀市猿島
2583.ed: Small, historic & uninhabited island popular for its swimming, cafes, barbecue spots & water sports.
2583.edj: 歴史のある小さな無人島。海水浴やウォーター スポーツ、バーベキューを楽しめるスポットやカフェが人気。

rv.t: Overall cool visit, not spectacular but was something to do. There is history to the island for those who are interested in that kind of thing. It's a short 10 minute ride via boat to the island and tickets were 2000 yen for adults, but Yokosuka residents receive a discount. In the summer, it is hot so bring water with you or you can get drinks from the vending machine. Also saw a small concession stand there but…

Definitely recommend this place for a short day-trip if you live in the area! I feel like it's a not so common travel destination so it wasn't too crowded - I was able to take a nice walk around the island, taking my time taking pictures and enjoying the sights! If you're not there for grilling or swimming and just plan seeing the island, I feel like one or max two hours are enough time, even if you walk at a slower…
The only uninhabited island in Tokyo bay. Amazing nature and historical fortress with lovely French brick tunnels. Ideal place for barbecue. ( you can rent all BBQ accessories here.)Love this island.

2584.a: Hatsushima Island Resort, 1113 Hatsushima, Atami, Shizuoka 413-0004, Japan
2584.aj: 〒413-0004 静岡県熱海市初島１１１３ PICA初島
2584.ed: Simple cottages in a casual island resort offering an outdoor pool, a restaurant & an open-air bath.
2584.edj: シンプルなコテージを備えた気取らないアイランド リゾート。屋外プール、レストラン、露天風呂がある。

rv.t: The closest island to Tokyo! It's tiny. We stayed in a camper! A hawk stole food right off our plate! Then we fed him our scraps. And did I mention it's an island! Cool! You take a ferry over. We had rough seas and kids sick. Take motion sickness meds! All kinds of good seafood to try at little places. Ferry dumps everyone so there are lines at first. Plan for it. There's a lot of walking to do so be ready. There's…
I visited this resort 12 years ago for a work trip! I loved it so much I’ve never forgotten it. The braised pork soup is outstanding—I still dream about it today.
BBQ Lobster was mealy and soft, shrimp too.. obviously frozen. No good. And very slow and ambivalent service. Felt not like japan

2585.a: Japan, 〒135-0006 Tokyo, Koto City, Tokiwa, 2 Chome−2−12 1階 iki Espresso
2585.aj: 〒135-0006 東京都江東区常盤２丁目２−１２ 1階 iki Espresso
2585.ed: Open-fronted contemporary cafe serving specialist coffee & an all-day menu of snacks & pastries.
2585.edj: こだわりのコーヒーが楽しめる開放型のモダンなカフェ。軽食、ペストリーを終日提供。

rv.t: The food and dessert selection is fantastic, from sandwiches and salads to cakes. The colorful desserts in the display case were particularly eye-catching. This time, I tried the pumpkin quiche and the meat pie. ​The quiche was rich in flavor with a wonderful combination of pumpkin, cheese, and rosemary. It paired perfectly with the New Zealand ketchup they served. The meat pie was also delicious, with the butter…

Everything we had for breakfast was absolutely delicious. Both the quality of the food and the presentation were excellent. The staff were very attentive and friendly, which made us feel very welcome. We especially loved the granola, and when we wanted to buy some, they kindly prepared a special package for us. Such a thoughtful gesture. Definitely a place we would love to visit again 😊

I came here a couple of times during my stay in the neighbourhood. As a kiwi who lives away from home, it made me happy to see a kiwi influence in the food. Coffee was good and staff were friendly. I prefer it to the roastery.

2586.a: Lawson Ashigara Service Area Nobori Shop, 1801-1 Fukasawa, Gotemba, Shizuoka 412-0023, Japan
2586.aj: 〒412-0023 静岡県御殿場市深沢１８０１−１ ローソン 足柄サービスエリア上り店
catj: コンビニエンスストア

rv.t: get some coke

🏪🌙 ローソン 足柄サービスエリア（上り）店 ― 深夜も安心✨旅の途中にホッと一息できる“青いコンビニオアシス”🚗💙 🚘 東名高速の人気サービスエリア「EXPASA足柄（上り）」の中にあるローソン🏞️✨ ドライブの休憩中にふらっと立ち寄れる安心感はさすが💡 夜遅くでも明るく営業していて、まさに“旅人の味方”といえる存在です🌙☕ 🍙 品ぞろえは定番中心ながら安定感あり🍞 おにぎり・サンドイッチ・カップ麺・スイーツなど、ラインナップはしっかり整っていて困ることなし👌 高速内のコンビニとしてはコンパクトですが、必要なものは一通りそろっています🎒✨ レジ横のホットスナックも人気で、ドライブ中に食べるからあげクンやフランクが最高にうまい😋🔥 💬 接客と雰囲気 スタッフさんの対応は丁寧で、忙しい中でも笑顔を見せてくれるのが印象的😊 ただし、深夜帯は少人数体制のようで、レジが混み合う時間帯には少し待ち時間が発生することも⌛💦 🚻…

2587.a: Kiyosumi Park, 2 Chome-2 Kiyosumi, Koto City, Tokyo 135-0024, Japan
2587.aj: 〒135-0024 東京都江東区清澄２丁目２ 清澄公園
2587.ed: Quiet park with a wooden clocktower & a kids' playground, known for spring blooms & fall foliage.
2587.edj: 木製の時計台や子供向けの遊び場がある、静かな公園。春の桜と秋の紅葉で知られる。

rv.t: Beautiful Classical Japanese garden. What makes the special is the size of the lake. Unfortunately, when I went, part of the lake was damned up for reconstruction and the height of the water elsewhere was a little low so it took a little bit of the magic away, but regardless it was a great place.

The Kiyosumi Park, next to the Kiyosumi Garden, is a calm place to walk, enjoy the trees and do some birdwatching. We visited stayed next to this park and visited it seven times in early morning. The garden opens at 9:00, so it's a nice place to wait too.
Very beautiful and relaxing. Lots of turtles in the water body. The park contains enough twists and turns to be exciting but not so many that would make you feel like you may miss out on something.

2588.a: Moegi Village, 3545 Takanecho Kiyosato, Hokuto, Yamanashi 407-0301, Japan
2588.aj: 〒407-0301 山梨県北杜市高根町清里３５４５ 萌木の村
2588.ed: Laid-back hotel within a forest resort, offering cozy quarters, a bar & 2 complimentary meals.
2588.edj: 森のリゾートにある居心地の良い客室を備えたホテル。バーを併設し、食事 2 回が無料。

rv.t: Free entry, no need to pay Place is huge and there’s plenty of parking. The shops and cafés are pretty decent too. Inside, there’s a super famous restaurant and another one called Rock. I went during lunchtime and had to wait almost an hour! Weirdly, there were still lots of empty seats inside, but they still kept us waiting in line. I guess only they know how the system works. 😅 Anyway, I ordered their most popular…

It’s autumn season and I love the halloween themed park! Pumpkins are decorated, there is a spot in the center of the park where you can get a really good pumpkin photo in aerial view lookout, and it was a bit cold so we had some S'mores outside! Coffee and cocoa were also available. Great place to get photo taken and if you love to go on a nature walk.
A very pretty village but what i found interesting was the trail (takimino-oka) that led to a viewing point of a waterfall. And it also has a story about fairies.

2588.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2589.a: Japan, 〒160-0022 Tokyo, Shinjuku City, Shinjuku, 3 Chome−1−17 ビル山本 2F AALIYA COFFEE ROASTERS
2589.aj: 〒160-0022 東京都新宿区新宿３丁目１−１７ ビル山本 2F AALIYA COFFEE ROASTERS
2589.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious French toast, which is often described as fluffy and juicy, and its flavorful coffee. They also highlight the calm atmosphere, making it a good spot to avoid crowds. Some reviews mention the space can be cramped.
2589.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、ふわふわでジューシーと評されるフレンチトーストや、風味豊かなコーヒーが高く評価されています。また、落ち着いた雰囲気も特徴で、混雑を避けたい人にとって良い場所という声もあります。 一方で、店内が狭いという意見も聞かれます。

rv.t: Extremely good coffee Roastery that is hidden from view. Peak Saturday at lunch time I struggled to get a seat anywhere for a quick coffee before going to the nearby cinema. This place soon filled up however after taking my seat! The latte art was gorgeous and was having regret looking at the French toast other patrons were having. The salted caramel cheesecake was still a delight and the coffee was perfectly…
Maybe closer to 3.5. French toast delicious. Carrot cake/muffin was okay. Coffee and chai watery (compared to Aussie standards). Was very quiet when we went both in atmosphere and customers.

Came here 10-ish on a Sunday morning, was pleased to have seats and be away from crowds in the streets. Yummy French toast and portions, the orders came within 10 mins which was reasonable. Coffee is good but sizes are slightly on the small side. Prepare your Google translate if you’re not a Japanese speaker. Good brunch spot nonetheless.

2589.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2590.a: Mochi Buta Tonkatsu Taiyo, メゾンいずみ第１ 3 Chome-22-7 Koyama, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 142-0062, Japan
2590.aj: 〒142-0062 東京都品川区小山３丁目２２−７ メゾンいずみ第１ もち豚とんかつ たいよう
2590.ed: Diners like this restaurant's tonkatsu, noting its light, crispy breading and tender, flavorful pork, with many highlighting the juicy loin and delicate fillet. They also appreciate the reasonable prices for set menus, which include delicious rice, pickles, and pork miso soup. Guests mention the calm, clean atmosphere and the attentive staff who prepare the food in front of them.
2590.edj: 厳選されたもち豚を使った手作りの豚カツが頂ける人気のお店。コンパクトでシックな店内はすっきりとして落ち着いている。

rv.t: I was able to walk in a Wednesday around 17.30. Beautifully lit, peaceful and quiet, this tiny restaurant serves the most perfect tonkatsu, prepared in front of you, as fresh as it gets. Crispy, golden brown and served with fluffy white rice and thinly shredded cabbage (do try the home made dressing) + home made pickles. The prices are very reasonable even for the set menus. Completely worth a visit.

I went there alone on rainy Tuesday around 7 30pm, no wait line yay! it was very delicious so I went there again the next day morning 11 am (they open at 11 30am) and a line was already formed! I ordered a different katsu, it was very good. it really wow-ed me. it looks simple, but it tastes different from other places. I wish I can eat this katsu in LA!

Tonkatsu was fluffy … the first bite, I felt a “porky” taste.. I don’t usually like my food with sauce so I ate it without anything and then added a bit of salt and a little sauce on the side. The batter was flaky and not oily.

2590.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30（土）

2591.a: Omedetaiyaki Honpo Togoshiginza Shop, 戸越小川ビル 1F 2 Chome-13-8 Hiratsuka, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 142-0051, Japan
2591.aj: 〒142-0051 東京都品川区平塚２丁目１３−８ 戸越小川ビル 1F おめで鯛焼き本舗 戸越銀座店
2591.edj: キャベツとベーコンが入ったお好み鯛焼きが名物。デニッシュたい焼きやチョコたい焼きなど、バリエーションも豊富。

rv.t: Tried this Okonomi Taiyaki for the sweet potato filling. The sweet potato taste nice 👍 but on the downside. Okonomi Taiyaki is cold, seems like put there for some time. Outside not crispy, was expecting at least warm inside. But really disappointed.
Maybe the shop staff rushed our order because the batter tasted a little uncooked inside. But the custard filling was good.
A bit disappointed as it was not served hot/warm

2591.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2592.a: Japan, 〒142-0051 Tokyo, Shinagawa City, Hiratsuka, 2 Chome−16−5 Caffe La Costa キャストアンカー戸越銀座1F
2592.aj: 〒142-0051 東京都品川区平塚２丁目１６−５ Caffe La Costa キャストアンカー戸越銀座1F

rv.t: I cannot express in words how much I enjoyed this cafe. House made ginger ale was perfect, specialty coffee was very satisfying and well priced. Cheesecake melts in your mouth and the sweetness id just right. The bagel was my favorite. It was warm, very chewy on the inside and lightly crispy on the outside, almost like mochi in bread form. It is one of the best bagels I have ever had. On top of the food and drinks…
Great coffee, delicious cheesecake, and one of a friendliest cafe around. Charming decor with a actual coffee roaster machine in front of the cafe. Highly recommended!
Delicious food and kind service! We really enjoy our time here!

2592.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2593.a: Kitchen TAIYO, 1 Chome-19-24 Togoshi, Shinagawa City, Tokyo 142-0041, Japan
2593.aj: 〒142-0041 東京都品川区戸越１丁目１９−２４ キッチンＴＡＩＹＯ(タイヨー)
catj: 日本式洋食レストラン
2593.ed: Diners like this restaurant's classic Western-style dishes, especially the juicy hamburg steak and flavorful demi-glace sauce, with generous portions. They also highlight the excellent value of the lunch sets, which include rice, soup, and a drink. Guests mention the quick service, friendly staff, and clean, welcoming atmosphere.
2593.edj: このレストランを訪れたユーザーは、昔ながらの洋食メニューを高く評価しています。特に、ジューシーなハンバーグステーキと風味豊かなデミグラスソース、そしてボリューム満点の料理が好評です。ランチセットはライス、スープ、ドリンクが付いており、そのコストパフォーマンスの高さも特徴です。また、提供時間の早さ、感じの良いスタッフ、清潔で居心地の良い雰囲気も良い点として挙げられています。

rv.t: We came this restaurant around 1130am. A few people already waited before us. The waitress was nice and welcome us. Less than 15 mins, the restaurant was almost full. Popular place to have a lunch. I order "set b of the day's special". The food was amazing and delicious. I highly recommend to have a meal if you come by. I'm looking forward to visiting here again.
Exceptional western food in the Togoshi hood with old-school Tokyo diner vibes. We went for dinner but they also have a popular lunch set. The Italian salad was really fun! Great Hamburg.

We stumbled upon this very warm and inviting place while visiting the country from the US. Make sure to know a few Japanese phrases and have Google Translate ready as there is no English in the menu nor photos of the food, and the cooks does not speak English either since this place is rather far from the touristy areas. Do not let that deter you from trying out this place! The food was delicious despite us never…

2593.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2594.a: Japan, 〒464-0850 Aichi, Nagoya, Chikusa Ward, Imaike, 3 Chome−17−8 マノアール今池 1階 hapuna coffee
2594.aj: 〒464-0850 愛知県名古屋市千種区今池３丁目１７−８ マノアール今池 1階 hapuna coffee
2594.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious hand-drip coffee, which offers a choice of single-origin beans, and its flavorful desserts like the rich cheesecake and firm pudding. They also highlight the calm and comfortable atmosphere, making it a great spot for solo visitors to relax. Guests mention the staff are kind and provide helpful explanations about the coffee beans.
2594.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、シングルオリジンの豆を選べるハンドドリップコーヒーや、濃厚なチーズケーキ、しっかりとした食感のプリンといったデザートが高く評価されています。また、落ち着いた雰囲気で居心地が良く、一人でもリラックスして過ごせる点も特徴です。スタッフは親切で、コーヒー豆について丁寧に説明してくれるという声もあります。

rv.t: Stopped in and had a wonderful pour over and yummy egg cake / flan. Staff member also had a good band / music recommendation. Stylish and comfortable inside space with local art. Lucky Nagoya coffee drinkers!
Great coffee and chill atmosphere here. The barista introduced different hand drip coffee choices and characteristics to you in English, which is very surprising for me!

Excellent cafe with a camping style in Nagoya. The coffee and their beans are first class, really good cp value for such good coffee. The pudding is first class as well. Really good place to chill after a day of touring! Came back a 2nd time and got some beans for a friend!

2594.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 9:00（土）

2595.a: Hanagoyomi kaiganten, 5-15 Shizumicho, Itō, Shizuoka 414-0042, Japan
2595.aj: 〒414-0042 静岡県伊東市静海町５−１５ はなごよみ海岸店
catj: シーフード・海鮮料理店
2595.ed: Diners like this restaurant's fresh seafood offerings, including generous portions of salmon and ikura bowls, and a special donburi with ten kinds of sashimi. They also highlight the perfectly grilled fish, such as crispy salted yellowtail, and the delicious horse mackerel tataki. Guests mention the staff are friendly and provide good service.
2595.edj: このレストランを利用した人は、新鮮な魚介類を使った料理を高く評価しています。特に、たっぷりのサーモンといくらがのった丼や、10種類の刺身が楽しめるスペシャル丼が人気のようです。また、完璧に焼かれた魚もおすすめとして挙げられています。皮がカリカリで身はふっくらとしたブリの塩焼きや、絶品のアジのたたきが美味しいというクチコミが多くあります。スタッフは感じが良く、良いサービスを提供しているという声もあります。

rv.t: Their menu is wonderful! Their sashimi tastes really fresh. They were very patient with us since we knew little Japanese and helped us understand the menu. Please try their fried chicken. It’s amazing!
Good Good

伊東の海沿いにある「ごはん処 花季 海岸店」に伺いました。今回注文したのは「サーモンいくら丼（2,200円）」。大正解でした！ ​どんぶりを覆い尽くすほどたっぷりと乗ったサーモンは、脂がしっかり乗っていて口の中でとろけます。その上に散りばめられたいくらのプチプチとした食感と程よい塩気が、サーモンの甘みをさらに引き立てていて、ご飯が止まらない美味しさでした。 ​伊東という立地ならではの新鮮な海の幸を、この価格でボリュームたっぷりに堪能できるのは非常にコストパフォーマンスが高いです。大満足の星5つ！伊東観光の際に美味しい海鮮を食べたい方に、全力でおすすめしたいお店です。

2595.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2596.ed: Island with temples & 2 suspension bridges, considered the birthplace of Japanese puppet theater.
2596.edj: 多くの寺院と 2 本の吊り橋で知られる島。人形浄瑠璃の発祥地と考えられている。

rv.t: Mysterious place with so many shrines and beautiful scenery. Fresh big-sized vegetables!

This is great island near kobe, one of the most beautiful and secluded place . Drive is amazing from Kobe to Awaji. Very famous for sweet onions 🧅. Highly recommend . Great food joint across the road side . On a good sunny day this is quite happening. Don’t miss the sunflower 🌻 orchid on the way to beach.

Words don’t describe this island. Japan in general is beautiful and if u r a driving enthusiast like me, then let’s take that car on the snake roads. Narrow streets and enjoy the sunset! Sounds of the waves and amazing food. There are plenty of temples and beachfronts here on this island. There is a very private restaurant called “Hato”. Absolutely amazing food. Don’t miss the southern side of the island. The bridge…

2597.aj: フィリピン ギマラス ギマラス島
2597.ed: Laid-back island known for its mangoes & serene beaches with unique rock formations.

rv.t: You can tour the island in one day using a Motorcycle ! Relaxing , beautiful place , not crowded at all…

Sometime ago when my soul was not in a good place, a wonderful friend made it possible for me to explore Guimaras. The beauty was captivating, the boat ride exhilarating, the company entertaining, the swim--in a protected sanctuary--soothing, and the experience healing. It was a gift for my aching soul. But I must say I got literally sick upon our anchorage which I attributed to overexposure to the elements. Lest I…

They said it’s mango Capital of the Philippines so I was expecting to taste or try their Mangoes but Unfortunately in the Beach Resort where I came they don’t have even MANGO shake. Guimaras is okay not wow beach I visited is Good but not exciting to go back again. Glad I visited the place it was a nice visit.

2598.a: Kamikochi Imperial Hotel, 上高地 Azumi, Matsumoto, Nagano 390-1516, Japan
2598.aj: 〒390-1516 長野県松本市安曇上高地 上高地帝国ホテル
2598.ed: Warm rooms & suites, some with balconies, in a serene lodging featuring multiple restaurants & bars.
2598.edj: 温かな雰囲気の客室とスイートを擁するホテル。一部の客室はバルコニー付き。複数のレストランとバーを併設。

rv.t: One of the best stays of the trip. The location is exceptional, fully immersed in nature with the surrounding forest and alpine scenery setting the tone from arrival. The hotel preserves its original character without feeling dated. The balance between the historic structure and modern additions is well handled. Service was excellent throughout, and the food matched the standard of the property. Notably, staff spoke…

We spent two nights and three days exploring the wonderful Kamikochi National Park in Nagano Prefecture, where we stayed at the outstanding Kamikochi Imperial Hotel. As an alpine lodge, it blows away any National Park property in the U.S. in terms of food and service, and is especially memorable if you're able to snag one of the handful of suites available. While there are plenty of scenic mountainous regions in…

Check-in at the Imperial Hotel, Kamikochi is from 2pm. We’d finished our walk and we’re ready to indulge. My darling husband had booked a deluxe twin room with double verandas. The rooms are gorgeous decorated with antique wood, upholstered double and single lounges, exquisite botanical prints through out, a wind up wooden musical box and a tantalising selection of cakes, chocolates and apple pastries. The views of…

2600.a: Kakita River Park, Shimizu, Sunto District, Shizuoka 411-0907, Japan
2600.aj: 〒411-0907 静岡県駿東郡清水町柿田川公園
2600.ed: Nature area featuring picturesque walking trails & spring-water pools originating from Mt. Fuji.
2600.edj: 美しい遊歩道を備えた自然エリア。富士山からの雪解け水が湧き出る取水口がある。

rv.t: Typically Naturally build garden saved as unesco heritage. Hiking track is about 30mints.across the river.Full of natural beauty and scenic views all around..One can feel full peace of mind. Tofu ice cream is famous local dish.Typical japanese restaurant can b find inside. Be the first to visit this beautiful natural scenic spot.
Very nice place to spend an evening. Perfect scenery, well maintained park, totally awesome views and don't forget to try the tofu ice cream!

Nice little park in the city. The springs come from water running underground from fuji. There's an open area and some small brief trails. I found the park quiet in the early hours. Bilingual signs make it easy to understand. It's pretty cool seeing the water pumping out of the ground from the well.

2601.a: NEPALICO Shibuya, 101 30-18 Sakuragaokacho, Shibuya, Tokyo 150-0031, Japan
2601.aj: 〒150-0031 東京都渋谷区桜丘町３０−１８ 101 ネパリコ 渋谷店 Nepalico shibuya SINCE 2010
2601.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and healthy Nepalese cuisine, especially the flavorful dal bhat, which features a mild bean soup, tender curries, and various vegetable dishes. They also highlight the friendly staff who offer timely refills of dal soup and rice, and appreciate the cozy, authentic atmosphere.
2601.edj: 健康志向で伝統的なネパール料理が頂けるレストラン。カジュアルで芸術的な店内はコンパクトで居心地がよい。ベジタリアンメニューもあり。

rv.t: Absolutely wonderful Nepal food. Everything we ordered was fantastic, so very hard to go wrong, but I'd still recommend trying the salad and (lamb) dumplings. Lamb lovers should definitely give this place a try or if you are into spices! Crowd Size: Very High (Reservation Recommended) Payment Method: Credit Card

Service was nice and I quickly got seated during lunch time. Food wise it was good but I was expecting more flavor from the food. Also the lamb was quite fatty and there wasn’t much of it. Still a solid lunch option in the neighborhood.

Great spot for some Nepalese food. The dinner set came with chicken curry and dal bhat, which were both delicious. You can actually get extra dal if you ask the staff. The momo were pretty good too. The staff was friendly and accommodating, and the restaurant has a cool Nepal themed layout. I highly recommend trying this place out. There’s one near Komazawa as well.

2601.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2602.aj: 〒158-0094 東京都世田谷区玉川１丁目１７−９ ビスケービル第２玉川 THE NORTH FACE STANDARD (ザ・ノース・フェイス スタンダード) 二子玉川
catj: アウトドア衣料・用品店

rv.t: This north-face store has a pretty cool vibe. They have a small coffee joint inside the store and serve awesome coffee. They do also have some food options to go along with coffee. I would highly recommend this over coffee chain brands. The clothes collection that they have here look very unique but are on the expensive side.

Pretty cool spot, wish there were more decent coffee spots in Futako Tamagawa. Had a pretty nice Macchiatto, the pulled pork sandwich looks great but I didn't eat. Will be back for coffee, as it's the best I've had around there.

Good drinks and some food in a small, stylish cafe. The other three floors sell clothing and outdoor gear. Coffee prepared on an espresso machine or hand drip from their own blend of beans. Some American style food items such as brownies, burritos, and sandwiches. The burrito I tried was a bit dry. Seating is at a long narrow bar or on wooden benches out front in good weather. They often have some interesting vinyl…

2603.a: CREVIA BASE Tokyo, 6 Chome-4-25 Toyosu, Koto City, Tokyo 135-0061, Japan
2603.aj: 〒135-0061 東京都江東区豊洲６丁目４−２５ CREVIA BASE Tokyo
2603.ed: People say this museum features a wide variety of authentic ancient Egyptian artifacts, including statues, jewelry, and animal mummies, with many items displayed up close. Visitors also highlight the engaging VR experience and the informative video explanations that enhance understanding. They also like that photography is permitted, allowing them to capture memories of the exhibits.
2603.edj: この博物館を訪れた人は、本物の古代エジプトのさまざまな工芸品が展示されていると評価しています。像や装飾品、動物のミイラなど、多くの展示品を間近で見られるのが特徴です。また、没入感のあるVR体験や、理解を深めるための分かりやすい映像解説も高く評価されています。展示品の撮影が許可されているため、思い出を残せる点も好評です。

rv.t: Currently the Pixar Mundo exhibition. They have some crowd control measures so that you're with a group of about 25-30 people. The employees do a good job of directing you to line up for the most sought-after pictures, and they'll take it for you if you don't have someone to do it. A fun exhibition. Took us a little less than 1.5 hours to complete.

I highly recommend the “Ramses the Great and the Gold of the Pharaohs” exhibit held here for all Egyptology lovers. The exhibits are very well exhibited and explained and the audio guide does a great job in complementing the exhibits. This exhibition is held with the support of the Egyptian embassy and it was mentioned that some of these exhibits will probably not leave Egypt for decades after the completion of this…
Nice ancient Egypt exhibition. They took true ancient relics form Egypt. The detail explained also nice. It will be a good experience for your child.

2603.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 10:00

2604.a: Japan, 〒153-0064 Tokyo, Meguro City, Shimomeguro, 1 Chome−8−1 Café Lounge Pandora, 目黒雅叙園
2604.aj: 〒153-0064 東京都目黒区下目黒１丁目８−１ カフェラウンジ パンドラ 目黒雅叙園
2604.ed: Upscale cafe in a light-filled atrium facing a pond, serving afternoon tea, cakes & sandwiches.
2604.edj: 池に面した明るいアトリウムに構える高級カフェ。アフタヌーン ティー、ケーキ、サンドイッチを提供。

rv.t: Ambiance is excellent. The cafe is inside of Gajoen hotel. They were able to preserve the greenery around the hotel specifically in the cafe. We were able to have a fun time while having afternoon tea. The cake and the sweets are not out of the ordinary though. But the place makes up for it. I will come back to try the lunch buffet near the cafe!

Super pretty and neat ambience. However, food was average. We did the afternoon tea set. Tea sandwiches were fine, but the pastries were mediocre. Scone was dense, hard, and dry, a far cry from what is expected of an afternoon tea. Other pastries were average. Pretty yes...but unremarkable. Service however was impeccable, as expected.

So came here the other day. Did not reserve so we had to wait over an hour Finally got in and what do you know… they don’t even got their star item they are known for. Came for the French toast but had to settle for their meh dessert 🍨😞 Such a waste of time. How do you sell out at 1pm? My gawd 👎 Such a shame since atmosphere and view is so lovely. Might try again in future Do note that they will add an extra service…

2605.a: Ohya Genki-ro No.06 AZUMAYA, 909番地11 Oyamachi, Utsunomiya, Tochigi 321-0345, Japan
2605.aj: 〒321-0345 栃木県宇都宮市大谷町909番地11 元気炉 六号基 ｜AZUMAYA
catj: アート ギャラリー

rv.t: Excellent concept and experience! You really have the feeling to delve inside of an art work installation. Things to bear in mind: It is not a sauna experience per se vit rather an art/sauna experience. It is not a dry sauna but steam sauna only. It's rough on the edges. To go in you have to crouch, it can get real hot, you're in the middle of nature and some insects can be expected. Once all that taken into account…
Cool place, must visit. But we had problems finding it

ようやく気になっていた、宇都宮・大谷にそびえ立つ“アートサウナ” 大谷元気炉六号基に行ってきました🌿 大谷石の採石場跡の空間に、ドーンと立っている一本の塔、アート作品でありながら、中に入ると面白い形をなしワクワクする本気のスチームサウナとなっており新感覚スポットでした！ 巨大な窯でハーブをぐつぐつ煮て、その蒸気をパイプで炉の中へ。扉を開けた瞬間、ふわっと広がるなんとも言えない香りが身体を包みます。スチームサウナ部分はアート作品で撮影禁止となっておりすのでぜひ訪れた際にお楽しみ下さい！ ヒノキの升が積み重なったような3層構造で、中の階段を上下しながら好みの“熱さポジション”を探して行きます。 上にいくほどしっかり熱いイメージがありますが、このスチームサウナは逆で、下がしっかり熱くて 上に行けば行くほど、じんわり深呼吸モード。スチームだから肌当たりが柔らかくて、「いつの間にこんなに汗かいた？」っというくらい全身がしっとりします。…

2606.a: Chidorigafuchi Park, 1 Chome-２ Kojimachi, Chiyoda City, Tokyo 100-0001, Japan
2606.aj: 〒100-0001 東京都千代田区麹町１丁目２ 千鳥ヶ淵公園
2606.ed: Long, narrow park following a palace moat, with a footpath & vibrant spring cherry blossoms.
2606.edj: お堀沿いの細長い公園で、歩道があり、春には桜の花が咲き乱れる。

rv.t: Came to Tokyo just in time as the Sakura season started. This park is beautiful as there are lots of cherry blossoms along the river. With the sun out, both locals and tourists enjoy walking and some even queue to go boating on the river. It’s a really pretty sight with lots of different colours. It’s a trip worth it. There’s no entrance fee too.

One of the best spots to see cherry blossoms in downtown Tokyo. We went to the area around 6:30am to avoid the crowds and it was worthy. Although it was past the peak by a couple of days, still incredible to see. Wear comfortable shoes to walk around.

Went on March 30 at around 6pm. Cherry blossom peak (80%) viewing. Very crowded but the crowd moved slowly. Came in from Kudanshita exit 2. Crowd control with one-way flow towards Hanzomon. The boats made the view extra nice.

2607.a: Sakura Garden, 1 Chome-5-1 Shibazono, Narashino, Chiba 275-0023, Japan
2607.aj: 〒275-0023 千葉県習志野市芝園１丁目５−１ 幕張 さくら広場
2607.ed: Vivid springtime displays of cherry blossoms in a manicured plaza with paths & water features.
2607.edj: 春には鮮やかな桜を楽しめる、遊歩道と水辺がある整備された広場。

rv.t: It is a place filled with sakura trees. It is less of a park because there is no place to sit down and have a picnic. It feels magical because of the beautiful trees when sakuras are full blooming. This year it bloomed early to mid April 2025 roughly 2 weeks span. It gets a bit crowded in the weekends but there should be enough trees for everyone to take solo pictures.

Very nice Sakura forest. The trees are individually grown equidistant from each other. There are over a 100 trees. All well taken care of. There is a pond in the other end of it and a slight hill to get a aerial view of all the trees below.

It's kind of an odd array of concrete and evenly placed cherry trees. At full bloom, there's no denying it is gorgeous, but in the absence of cherry blossoms I can't think of a reason to go. We unfortunately chose a cool day a bit too early to see blooms

2608.a: Japan, 〒275-0011 Chiba, Narashino, Okubo, 3 Chome−11−19 大和屋ビル 2階 noma books
2608.aj: 〒275-0011 千葉県習志野市大久保３丁目１１−１９ 大和屋ビル 2階 noma books

rv.t: Comfortable, modern looking cafe-bookstore. As others commented, it's not huge but but does have a kids corner which is great. It also has power and free wifi so you can hang out and telework too whilst getting light refreshment and food.
Upcoming exam? This is the best place to study!
20年振りに足を踏み入れました。本屋だけでは無いと聞いていましたが、カフェも併設されています。店主こだわりの本達が迎えてくれる少し変わった本屋です。2階にあるぶん、初めての方は入りづらいかもしれませんが、勇気を出して入ってみる価値がありますよ。店のむかいは長年、社交ダンスのドレスなどを手がける老舗の銘店のようです。

2609.a: Menya Tokishige Keisei Okubo, 1 Chome-18-9 Okubo, Narashino, Chiba 275-0011, Japan
2609.aj: 〒275-0011 千葉県習志野市大久保１丁目１８−９ 麺屋時茂 京成大久保店
2609.ed: Diners like this ramen shop's rich and flavorful toripaitan ramen and tsukemen, with many highlighting the excellent soup and tender rare chashu. They also appreciate the beautiful presentation of the dishes and the attentive staff who explain how to best enjoy the ramen. Guests mention the tsukemen is served with an IH cooker, keeping the soup hot throughout the meal.
2609.edj: このラーメン店を利用した人は、濃厚で風味豊かな鶏白湯ラーメンやつけ麺を高く評価しています。特に、スープの美味しさや、やわらかいレアチャーシューを絶賛する声が多くあります。盛り付けの美しさや、ラーメンを一番美味しく食べる方法を丁寧に説明してくれるスタッフの対応も好評です。つけ麺はIHコンロで提供されるため、食事が終わるまでスープが熱々で楽しめるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: Very thick and strong flavor chicken broth. Taste great!!

人気店故に混雑しています。雰囲気は悪くないのですが、店主が少し威圧感があるでしょうか。気弱な方は少し驚くかもしれません。実際はとても親切なので大丈夫です。注文について細かくリクエストを聞いてくれます。 味は文句なくレベル高いです。色々と創意工夫がしてあり見た目もこだわっています。仕上がりがとてもキレイです。つけ麺はコンロを使用しますので、スープの温度はいつでも食べ頃に保ってくれます。 しかし店が狭いわりに席数が多いので窮屈感はあります。 また、入り口がラーメン屋さんとわかりにくいので、ついつい通り越してしまうかもしれません。 私は、ぜひこれこらも通いたい名店と感じました。
前から入ってみたかった鶏白湯系のつけ麺屋さん。IHに器を乗せて食べるタイプなので、つけ麺が最後まで温かい。珍しがって煮立つところを動画撮ってたら一瞬で煮溢れてしまいました、テーブル汚してすみません！ 麺が覆われるくらいもられている野菜がシャキッとしてスープに合います。具材一つ一つがとてもおいしく、ぜひまた来たいです。

2609.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:30

2610.a: Japan, 〒274-0072 Chiba, Funabashi, Miyama, 7 Chome−1−1 ケーキハウス ノア
2610.aj: 〒274-0072 千葉県船橋市三山７丁目１−１ ケーキハウス ノア

rv.t: A great bakery in the area. With many different choices of sweets. Location is aesthetically pleasing, clean and has great customer service. Packaging is easy to carry whether you're walking or driving a car, the desserts won't get ruined. Definitely try if you're in the area.

二宮神社のすぐ近くにあるケーキ屋さんです。 どなたかのブログを見て、バスの待ち時間に利用させていただきました。 テイクアウトが主流だと思われる内装ですが、端に小さなテーブルとベンチがあり、イートインでも良いかと聞いたら快諾してくださいました。 頼んだのはアイスコーヒーと杏仁豆腐。 さっぱりした味ととろっとした舌触りで、暑くなってきたこの時期にぴったりで美味しかったです。 写真に残しておけばよかった・・・ お店を出たあとで、店主さんがわざわざクッキーのおまけを届けて下さいました。 こちらのクッキーもおいしかったです！ また神社に来た際には寄らせていただきたいと思います。

ガソリンスタンドの冊子でお店を知り、Instagramでお店やケーキを拝見し伺いました。 二ノ宮神社のすぐ横にあります。 個人経営のこういう感じのケーキ屋さん、めっきり少なくなってしまいましたが、ここにありき！でした。 たくさん種類があり、これ作るの大変だろうなぁなんて考えながらワクワクしながら選びました。甘さ控えめの食べ応えのあるケーキを今回は選びました。 次回また今回と違うケーキを買いに伺います。

2611.a: Kurumian, メゾン都築 1F 4 Chome-2-1 Okubo, Narashino, Chiba 275-0011, Japan
2611.aj: 〒275-0011 千葉県習志野市大久保４丁目２−１ メゾン都築 1F 信州手打そば処 くるみ庵
2611.ed: Diners like this soba restaurant's delicious soba noodles, with options for thin or flat noodles, and tempura, which includes two shrimp. They also highlight the pleasant, traditional atmosphere and the option to enjoy alcoholic beverages. Other reviews mention there can be long wait times.
2611.edj: このそば店を訪れたユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しいそばが高く評価されています。そばは細麺と平麺から選べ、天ぷらにはエビが2本含まれているようです。また、趣のある落ち着いた雰囲気や、アルコール飲料を楽しめる点も好評です。 一方で、待ち時間が長いというクチコミも多く見られます。

rv.t: 土曜日の午前11時ちょっとすぎに着きましたが私より先に来てた客は１組のみとまだ空いてました。でも30分もたつとだいぶ満席に近くなってゆきました。店を出る時には外に待ち列ができてました。土曜ということもあろうが他の人の口コミを読んでも人気そば店であることが分かります。雰囲気はなかなか趣があり良いです😊。信州の産地に来てるみたいだ。親子丼セットで1710円を注文しました。ちょっとがっかりしたお味でした。特に天ぷらがダメだと思いました。仕上がり感がなんか雑に感じるし味もイマイチ。衣がガチガチに硬いなー。親子丼の味付けも好みじゃない。品のない安っぽい感じの味。蕎麦自体が一番まともかな…。でも…ちょっと芯が硬く感じます。だからなのか喉腰がイマイチかも。店の雰囲気佇まいからなかなかおいしそうなお蕎麦屋さんに見えたがその割にサッパリの印象です😨。

夜訪問。まず通されたテーブルに前の客のものであろうおしぼりのゴミがあり、ここで違和感を感じるも、メニューを見る。 エビ天丼が美味しそうだったが野菜も欲しかったので、エビ天丼をエビ少なめ、野菜に変更できるか店員さんに聞いたら「そのようなサービスはありません。」と返事。なら他のをと、メニューよく見たら五種盛り天丼を発見。え、これを教えてくれたら良かったのになと思いながらタブレットで注文。全然来ません。一人でオーダーをこなしてるのか周りのお客さんも待っている状態。やっと来たと思ったらご飯が普通盛りなのに少ない。天丼は美味しかった。蕎麦も食べたが美味しかった。雰囲気と料理は良かったので、提供スピードと店員さんの接客に改善を期待したい。
平日ランチ 平日だから予約しなくても大丈夫かなと思って しかーし💦2時間近く待ち オーダーから1時間ほど待ってようやく食べることが💦 途中、帰ろうかと話しもでましたが年の瀬に美味しいお蕎麦を食べたいと思っていたため長ーーく待ちました 他にも同じように待っている家族などもいたため通常な待ち時間なのか？？ フロアを一人で回していたため本当に大変そうでした

2611.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

2612.a: Japan, 〒275-0012 Chiba, Narashino, Motookubo, 3 Chome−8−21 プロシード京成大久保 PHILOCOFFEA プラッツ習志野店
2612.aj: 〒275-0012 千葉県習志野市本大久保３丁目８−２１ プロシード京成大久保 PHILOCOFFEA プラッツ習志野店
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
2612.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious, high-quality coffee, including single-origin options, along with tasty cheesecakes, firm puddings, and fresh hamburgers. They also highlight the bright, stylish, and relaxing atmosphere, making it a comfortable place to unwind. Visitors appreciate the knowledgeable and friendly staff who provide excellent service and helpful recommendations.
2612.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、シングルオリジンを含む高品質でおいしいコーヒーが提供されていると評判です。また、おいしいチーズケーキ、しっかりとした固さのプリン、新鮮なハンバーガーも高く評価されています。店内は明るくおしゃれで、リラックスできる雰囲気のため、快適に過ごせるという声が多くあります。知識が豊富で親しみやすいスタッフが素晴らしいサービスと的確なアドバイスを提供してくれる点も、訪れた人に喜ばれています。

rv.t: Inside the shiny new city hall building, walk down the steps into the plaza. Amazing coffee (the kind of place that lets you choose the country where your beans are from), they have lattes, hot and iced coffee, caffeine free, caramel macchiato. Sweets are quite limited and expensive, 700yen for a slice of cheesecake, they also have pudding, no pastries unfortunately

初めてパラグライダーしましたが、ハマってしまいました！！ 飛んでいる時、緩急つけてくれるので、迫力もあって、気持ちよくて、一瞬で終わりました☺️ あとインストラクターの方も優しく対応いただき、また行きたいなと思います！ 駅までの送迎ありがとうございました😊

At Sakura no Sato, located at the foot of Mount Omuro, we highly recommend visiting to experience its beauty in every season.

曹洞宗林泉寺は300年ほど前に信者が寄進した2本の藤の古木があり 1970年に静岡県の天然記念物にされたそうです。 花の長さが1.5mになるものもあるそうですが今年はまだ早かったようです。 2022年4月17日訪問。

The space is small, but still felt comfortable and the music was fun as well. I got the ChoCoffee bowl. The texture was fluffy and so smooth and the flavor amazing! It was so delicious! I would recommend!!

2025年2月頃に行きました。 15時くらいの時間帯だったので、店内は空いていて静かに過ごせました。海外のジューススタンドのような雰囲気があり、少し日本にいることを忘れるような空間です。 注文したスムージーボウルはフルーツがたっぷりのっていて、味も本格的でした。見た目以上に満足感があります。メニューがいろいろあって迷いましたが、店員さんが丁寧に内容を説明してくれたので、初めてでも選びやすかったです。 支払いはPayPayに対応していたので、財布を出さずに決済できて楽でした。お店の専用駐車場はなさそうなので、車の場合は周辺のコインパーキングを利用することになります。体に良さそうなメニューが多いので、また近くに来た際は立ち寄りたいと思います。
本格派ジュースバー。種類いろいろ。 店員さんの感じがいい。 クレカが使えない。

2628.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious, hearty acai bowls with fresh fruit and a satisfying texture, along with flavorful salads and vegan tacos. They also highlight the clean, cozy, and relaxing atmosphere, making it a great spot for solo visits or with friends. Guests mention the staff are kind, welcoming, and provide helpful recommendations.
2628.edj: このカフェを利用した人は、新鮮なフルーツがたっぷりのった、食べ応えのあるアサイーボウルや、風味豊かなサラダ、ヴィーガンタコスを高く評価しています。清潔感があり、居心地の良い落ち着いた雰囲気も特徴で、一人でも友人とでも利用しやすいという声が多くあります。スタッフは親切で、丁寧な対応やおすすめのメニューを教えてくれるというクチコミもあります。

rv.t: A very cozy, nicely designed space. Great for solo dining or for a one-on-one. It was also great to finally find a spot that does warm healthy bowls, with a mix of protein and veggies. Their lunch sets have a nice variety that let you taste a bit of everything. My main gripe is the portion is a little too small for me for the price. I think for most women it’s fine, but I’m a hungry boi and I’d need two of these…
Absolutely the best açaí bowl I’ve ever had! The atmosphere is so warm and welcoming. I really liked the vibe here. You’d better come early—around 9:50 AM, just a few minutes before they open.

A modern vegan restaurant of the kind often found in Los Angeles—not simply a place serving vegetables for the sake of it, but one with a menu thoughtfully designed to provide a balanced range of nutrients, including protein and other essentials. The dishes are fresh, high-quality, and prepared to order, without compromising on taste. The atmosphere is pleasant, although the main reason to come is the food. The…

2629.ed: Diners like this cafe's delicious and healthy acai bowls, avocado toast, and coffee, with many vegan and gluten-free options available. They also highlight the friendly and attentive staff, as well as the clean and cozy atmosphere with soothing music. Guests mention the accessible restrooms and the option to bring pets inside.
2629.edj: このカフェを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、美味しくてヘルシーなアサイーボウル、アボカドトースト、コーヒーが高く評価されています。ヴィーガンやグルテンフリーの選択肢も豊富に用意されているようです。また、親しみやすく気の利くスタッフ、清潔で居心地の良い空間、心地よい音楽も特徴として挙げられています。バリアフリー対応のトイレやペット同伴が可能な点も、利用した人から良いクチコミが多くあります。

rv.t: Wonderful coffee, food, and atmosphere! I ordered the avocado set + a coffee. The food was so fresh and beautifully displayed. You can tell there’s a lot of care in their food and ingredients. I especially loved the açaí bowl as it was very refreshing. The service was polite and the place was cute/cozy with good music. This is a great place if you’re looking for something rather quick, clean, and plant-based options!

Nestled in the outskirts of the hustle and bustle of Aoyama, near the iconic Olympic stadium is Tree by Naked. Very sheek and the perfect atmosphere for a relaxing Sunday Açaí Bowl or maybe the Berry and granola. All Vegan and Gluten free. Very refreshing.
A welcome cooling hideaway and respite from a warm summer morning. Avocado toast portion is generous, and wlel balanced with notes of olive oil. Lemon adds a nice touch.

rv.t: I went on a Thursday around noon and got a table right away. The cafe is pretty small with just a few tables, but the interior is really nicely decorated and the vibe is calm and relaxing. I also enjoyed the music they played. You order through a QR code and the food came out pretty quickly. The iced latte had a really nice flavor and was a good size. The acai bowl was good too, simple but in a good way. I liked…

⏱️ Fast service: 5/5 🫶 Friendly service: 5/5 🥗 Tasty food: 5/5 💸 Value for money: 5/5 I absolutely love that the place is not easy to find - you have to know it to get here. It's authentic to the point where you need Line app to order. The interior is minimalistic and delicate, and contrasts sharply with rap music being played. I loved it. Food is like artwork both in terms of how it's served, and also in terms of…

Lovely atmosphere in this hidden spot away from the crowds. As somebody else mentioned, it’s a small menu but has something for everybody: açaí bowls, soups and savory breakfast options. We absolutely loved the Super Bowl açaí, and the gratin soup was a nice breakfast too. Sitting at the window is the perfect way to start a quiet morning. Hip hop, relaxing music and atmosphere!

rv.t: Hidden gem 💎 Cozy little spot just three minutes off the main road. Açaí bowls with tons of topping to customize, plus really good looking focaccias — and for just a few extra yen you can add a mini açaí bowl to your focaccia (gluten feee option available) The owners are super friendly too. Highly recommend!
A cozy place to get an açai bowl. The staff are friendly and they put a lot of care into the food that they make.

Very high quality fruit, the kind you’ve heard Japan having. Delicious bowls, the yogurt was sublime, where the texture was very creamy but light. Honeycomb melted in my mouth great deliciousness. All gluten free!!!

Stumbled upon this place while waiting for a pop-up shop nearby and I’m glad we found it. It’s a cute cafe to grab a healthier sweet treat. I ordered a Greek yogurt bowl and it was pretty good! It satisfied my sweet tooth. It is a bit pricey though but I still enjoyed it!
One of the best açai bowls I’ve ever had. Really fresh, delicious, amazing flavours. And the hosts are very nice. Really great experience!

cute little smoothie shop in the Tokyu Shopping Plaza, 3rd floor. Nice and the refreshing on this hot summer day (97 degrees Fahrenheit today!) the tropical smoothie was tasty and not overly sweet. The also offer smoothie bowls as well for something a bit more substantial. Worth a stop in!!

The food here is so good. We had the açaí bowl and Croque Monsieur. The fresh baked wheat bread on the sandwich was so fluffy. Also the tea is very good. They have an English menu and the service is very friendly.

Ordered this place on uber eats. Jesus christ daylight robbery. The prices were about ¥400 higher than the quality received. Major disappointment. Look at the ice to coffee ratio for a ¥1000+ coffee. Ridiculous. They packed an acai bowl without a spoon…all around joke of a shop. Wish I could get my money back.

After picking up your bowl, there’s a standing bar…
